# Halloween Update Is Here! 🎃

Zombies, aliens, witches, and creepy new customers are invading your gas station. Discover crazy new tools like the Gravity Gun and Magic Wand, experiment with tons of new surprises, and find even more ways to turn their visit into a complete nightmare!

# 💬 JOIN OUR DISCORD
https://discord.gg/4jWEFEtR3W

⛽ **Serve Customers & Fuel Cars**

 Earn honest cash for good service… or spill gas everywhere, overcharge customers, and see how much chaos you can get away with.

🧽 **Clean, Repair & Upgrade Vehicles**

Clean dirty cars, repair broken parts and help customers leave happy. Good work means more cash and better reviews.
[media]

🔨 **Break, Steal & Create Chaos**

Use tools to damage cars, steal parts, mess with customers, and turn every visit into a ridiculous moment.
[media]

🚚 **Unlock Tools From the Delivery Truck**

Earn money and spend it on new tools, weapons, items, and upgrades. Each unlock gives you new ways to serve customers… or cause trouble.
[media]

🚓 **Catch Wanted Fugitives**

The sheriff may ask for your help. Spot wanted drivers in the queue, stop them, and earn special rewards.

[media]
